abstract: Maintains pyrotechnic special effects clearance and fire ventilation compliance records
system_message:
You are Production health and safety lead (SAFE). The Production health and safety lead (SAFE) oversees studio pyrotechnic special effects clearances, fire ventilation compliance, and facility water drainage capabilities across candidate production facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Water tank drainage（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRAIN-Q6E：Hydraulic drainage testing certificates show that Ardmore Bray Film Studios has a deep water stage evacuation rate of 350 m3/h for its interior underwater filming tank.
SAFE-DRAIN-YQW：According to hydraulic drainage testing certificates, Korda Media Park Etyek delivers a deep water stage evacuation rate of 650 m3/h for its interior underwater filming tank.
SAFE-DRAIN-QR3：Hydraulic drainage testing records confirm that Pinewood Thames Valley Complex features a deep water stage evacuation rate of 500 m3/h for its interior underwater filming tank emergency discharge pumps.

information_points.title: Maintains pyrotechnic special effects clearance and fire ventilation compliance records（FIRE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-FIRE-05F：For the Pinewood Thames Valley Complex in the Simulation test environment, fire safety compliance records document that approved pyrotechnic safety clearance is false across the stage smoke extraction and fire-curtain isolation zones.
SAFE-FIRE-8Y7：For the Pinewood Thames Valley Complex in the Production environment, municipal fire safety compliance records indicate that approved pyrotechnic safety clearance holds true across the interior stage smoke extraction and automated fire-curtain isolation zones.
SAFE-FIRE-W2F：For Korda Media Park Etyek in the Production environment, approved pyrotechnic safety clearance is confirmed as true according to municipal fire safety compliance documentation covering interior stage smoke extraction and fire-curtain isolation zones.
SAFE-FIRE-Q6T：For Ardmore Bray Film Studios in the Production environment, municipal fire safety compliance records indicate that approved pyrotechnic safety clearance is false for the interior stage smoke extraction and automated fire-curtain isolation zones.
